Canon's MF260 series datasheet identifies this model family as multifunction monochrome printers with scanning; series-level self-report does not select a specific MF264/MF267/MF269 variant.
The manufacturer's brochure identifies the exact M8124cidn as a multifunction printer with scanning; a scanner service alone does not establish this chassis type.

HP identifies M227-M229 and M230-M231 as multifunction LaserJet printer families with scanning. The observed DNS-SD model reports the combined M227-M231 family; retain that granularity and do not infer M227fdn from the service instance name.

The manufacturer DS-7800N-Q2 datasheet explicitly lists DS-7808N-Q2 as an NVR. Only this complete SADP self-reported model is reviewed; the vendor, numeric DeviceType and near-match suffixes do not establish a hardware type.

The H3C E500C product page explicitly identifies E528C-PWR as an Ethernet switch. This exact model may be taken from an attributed response via the pinned LibreNMS Comware hardware capture. H3C vendor, enterprise OID and other Comware models remain insufficient; historical SNMP aggregates without ownership are excluded.

H3C hardware specifications explicitly name S5570S-28S-HPWR-EI-A as a switch. The complete suffix is retained; use only an attributed hardware self-report or complete matching Comware response. No broad H3C-to-switch inference is permitted.
